root_idea.summary: The supplied evidence centers on elevation, upward movement, and the projection or drawing of something: water is drawn or made to irrigate, light rises and shines, and elevation extends figuratively to rank.
root_idea.development: The same semantic field links drawing water upward through a well, bright or rising light, physical ascent, and exalted condition. These root-level relationships should not be read as meanings of every individual Quranic form.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Independent Quranic nominal meaning: bright or flashing light.
Displayed under the normalized singular citation form سنة.
The Quranic plural سنين is the plural of سنة and is presented under the singular dictionary headword.
The non-nominal temporal occurrence uses the same lexical item and is presented under سنة rather than as a separate form.

senses.definition: Bright, shining light or gleam; in the Quranic occurrence, the flash or glare of lightning.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of the conspicuous radiance or flash of light. The Quranic expression concerns lightning.

quranic_forms.public_pos_label: Noun · year (including plural and temporal use)

senses.definition: A year: a recurring period of time measured by a solar or lunar cycle; plural سنين, “years.”
senses.usage_conditions: The form occurs in singular, plural, and temporal constructions. The evidence allows both solar and lunar reckoning without making either one obligatory in every occurrence.

senses.definition: A year understood as a period of hardship, difficulty, or dearth, especially in contrast with عام.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a reported Quranic lexical nuance in the contrast between سنة and عام; it is not a restriction that applies to every occurrence of سنة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To water or irrigate land; of rain or a cloud, to supply land with water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of a camel, beast, or people engaged in drawing water from a well for irrigation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise or aspire to eminence; to become high or exalted in rank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from upward movement or height.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ascend or mount upon something; of a male animal, to mount a female for mating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sexual sense is a specific animal-mounting construction, not a general restriction on the verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To open or unlock; to make a matter or way easy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a knot, lock, door, affair, or course of action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek agreement or conciliation through gentleness; to treat someone with tact, soothing, or blandishment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes consenting, harmonizing with another, and behaving well in social dealings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hire or contract with someone by the year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contractual or employment arrangement measured annually.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise, exalt, or elevate someone or something; to increase an amount or reward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes raising a fire’s light and making a payment, prize, or remuneration larger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make good or improve a protective covenant or grant of protection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use applied to a person’s protective relationship or covenant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of lightning, to send or cast its light into a house, tent, or chamber, onto the ground, or along the clouds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The described occurrence is specifically nocturnal lightning illumination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a people, to remain in a place for a year, or until a year has passed over them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes residence or duration measured by the passing of a year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be afflicted with drought or barrenness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is reported as an orthographically distinguished form from أَسْنَى, with the final radical represented by ت in this drought sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ascend or rise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a use of the verb for a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To open or become open.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a lock or similar object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become facilitated, ready, or easy; to find ease in one’s affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may describe either the becoming easy of a matter or a person’s experiencing ease in affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek to please, content, or satisfy someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional interpersonal use involving effort to gain another’s satisfaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain or dwell with someone, or at someone’s abode, for a year or several years.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The duration may be understood as one year or, in another explanation, several years.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become altered or lose freshness through the lapse of years.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported derivation is disputed; the meaning is preserved as an independently attested lexical use without assigning Lane’s historical Quran citation a modern verse location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look at the light of a fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized visual-response construction involving firelight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The senna plant, used medicinally and also as a collyrium.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant-name homonym, distinct from سَنَا meaning light.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an Abyssinian expression, to be or become good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal or borrowed expression, distinct from the Arabic light and irrigation meanings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food or grain that has undergone the lapse of years and become aged.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use applied to food or wheat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Drought, barrenness, or severe drought; of land, a drought-affected condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropicalized use of سنة, including its use as an epithet of land, distinct from the ordinary temporal meaning “year.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hard, rigorous, or distressing year; of land, affected by drought or barrenness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival form describing severity or drought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Brightness or light emitted by fire or lightning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun and lexical form distinct in shape from the Quranic noun سَنَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High or exalted rank or condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized use referring to status or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High or exalted in rank or condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to a person or to status.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wholly or entirely; in the idiom, to take something in its entirety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiomatic expression أخذَهُ بِسِنَايَتِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person or camel that waters land or draws water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial designation applied to either the human operator or the animal used in the work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel or other beast used to draw water from a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The animal may be male or female and may operate a drawing arrangement or water wheel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The large water-drawing bucket together with its gear or apparatus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metonymic equipment sense of the same lexical item.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloud that waters the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the water-drawing or watering function.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dam, sluice-bearing structure, or wall built to hold back or regulate flowing water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A constructed water-control work, including a structure with openings through which water is regulated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well with a long rope from which water is drawn using a سَانِيَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The well’s depth or rope arrangement makes animal-powered drawing necessary.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Drawing water by animal, people, or bucket.

Ascending or mounting, including the animal mating construction.
Hiring or contracting by the year.

Lightning casting or sending its light.

Abyssinian expression meaning to be good.
Year, the سنة/عام nuance, and the independently reported drought use.
سنة used alone for drought or barrenness.

Idiomatic sense of taking something wholly.
Well designed for animal-powered water drawing.

cautions: The plural and temporal non-nominal Quran occurrences of سِنِينَ are merged under the normalized singular headword سَنَة.
The reported سنة/عام hardship nuance is lexical rather than a condition on every occurrence of سنة.
The derivation and Quranic association reported for تَسَنَّى in the sense “become altered with age” are disputed; no modern verse location is assigned from that discussion.
Lane’s historical Quran citation for the سنة/عام discussion is not used as a modern location; Quran examples here use independently supplied QAC locations.
